description: Imported screen data and backing-store identity.
Resolved requested scientific and configuration choices.
Durable design, source assignments, QC payloads and completed preparation records.
Compact reusable response fits for one actual fitting scope.
Completed tables with their own provenance, validity identity and history.
Saved schema version; scalar integer 3.
Original response labels aligned with response rows, used for mitochondrial summaries; empty when legacy labels are unknown.
Typed CountStore: row-accessible dgRMatrix, or BackedCountStore owning a descriptor and optional live handle; NULL only before import or for legacy unavailable counts.
Typed CountStore with the same ordered source cells as responses; backed stores retain dimensions and labels when closed.
One row per source cell: imported count summaries and supplied extra covariates.
Canonical imported guide-to-target metadata, preserving supplied row order and multiplicity.
Whether the screen is analyzed as low MOI.
Source-cell-aligned maximum-guide labels and maximum-guide UMI fractions computed at import or supported replacement.
Content/metadata fingerprint assigned at import or supported replacement; active backing files are immutable by contract.
Canonical requested discovery target-response rows, without derived guide expansion.
Canonical requested positive-control target-response rows, without derived guide expansion.
Resolved requested model formula; the actual compiled design belongs to preparation.
Requested test direction: -1 left, 0 both, 1 right.
Requested tail policy: skew_normal or no_approximation.
TRUE selects complement controls; FALSE selects nontargeting controls.
TRUE selects permutation resampling; FALSE selects CRT.
Minimum treatment observations for pair eligibility.
Minimum control observations for pair eligibility.
Requested guide integration: union, singleton or bonferroni.
Resolved guide-assignment choice: maximum, thresholding or mixture.
Method-specific requested assignment settings, including any assignment-model formula.
Requested reporting significance threshold; also determines empirical resampling precision.
Requested complete-family multiple-testing correction method.
Requested UMI/nonzero quantile ranges and mitochondrial-fraction cutoff.
Additional source-cell positions explicitly excluded by the requested QC configuration.
Actual compiled model matrix, one row per source cell, with design columns, contrasts and ordering retained.
Cached NT-guide-by-response stored-entry counts used by calibration.
Cached per-response stored-entry totals: all selected cells for complement controls, or summed NT-group counts for NT controls (overlaps count again).
Compiled discovery rows with treatment/control counts and eligibility decisions, including failed-QC rows.
Compiled positive-control rows with treatment/control counts and eligibility decisions.
Named individual-guide memberships in canonical source-cell coordinates, durable before QC.
Target/guide groups and individual NT memberships in source-cell coordinates.
Groups remapped to analysis/NT-fit coordinates after cell QC, including the ordered NT-to-analysis mapping.
Cached per-cell assignment counts used for low-MOI exclusions and assignment diagnostics.
Source cells excluded because assignments are absent or ambiguous under the chosen assignment method.
Ordered source-cell positions retained by cell QC.
Named counts of QC exclusion reasons; reasons may overlap.
Completed design/assignment/cell_qc/pair_qc records. An entry exists only after validation; its identity and prerequisites determine readiness.
Derived group labels aligned one-for-one with canonical guide metadata rows; no duplicated metadata table.
Compiled discovery target-to-guide-group expansion, preserving requested row multiplicity.
Compiled positive-control target-to-guide-group expansion.
Named response fits: each contains fitted_coefs and scalar theta. Identifiers, coefficient/design compatibility and dispersion are validated.
Actual data identity, ordered fitting cells, ordered design columns, design-value fingerprint and fitter version for all cached entries.
Completed run entries keyed by analysis name. Each owns its table, frozen spec/run plan, scope, identity and previous run history; invalidated_by explains historical status.
Boundary-only migration diagnostics, such as old schema version, discarded fit count or a temporary legacy reopen hint; not workflow state.
Ordered positions in the selected analysis cells used for this fit.
The corresponding ordered original count-matrix columns.
Treatment positions within this fit.
Validated treatment-position count; transient numerical convenience.
Authoritative backing path, anchored content_md5, integer dimensions, dimnames and native integer_id; validated on creation and reopening.
Process-local external pointer when open, NULL when closed; never used as content identity.
